style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight
subject: ONE herring in a seller apron, silver blue back, big round eye, fins used as hands
second_characters: two shrimps in visors, buyers, big at the lens, small at the edges at the end

props.big: ONE huge glass jar packed with orange roe, as tall as the hero
props.small: ONE tiny glass jar, thumb sized, exactly three roe beads in it
props.card: ONE price card, 1499 in four digits of one height in a row, turned flat to the lens

environment: a market stall in a wall of kelp and crates filling the frame to its top edge, sand and scales blowing
lighting: bright white daylight in clear turquoise water, cyan edge left, warm amber fill right
motion_rule: the camera circles the hero inside the kelp and never stops, new shot size every beat, medium to close, the hero filling half the frame height from the first frame. He throws his whole body the full frame width every beat, mouth to the lens. The world flies INTO the lens: jars, kelp and shrimps rush at the glass every beat. ONE hero action per beat.

audio.rate: 3.8 syllables per second, each line fits its beat
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, the line is said once and ends by 5.75, then glass and sand carry it
audio.lip_sync: the herring speaks on camera, mouth to the lens and opening on every syllable, nothing in it
audio.pronunciation: in-FLYA-tsi-ya, FI-cha, pri-spo-SO-bi-lis, ik-RA, te-PER, zu-BOK

timeline.a: hauls the huge jar of roe, packed to the lid, the full frame width at the lens; a shrimp swings its visor across the glass
heaves that huge jar onto the crates and the roe piles at the glass; the other shrimp drags a crate over the lens
rips the lid off the huge jar and flings it over the lens, body edge to edge; both shrimps dive under it
beats the heap of crates apart with his tail and it collapses at the lens, lids flying past the glass
drives his mouth at the lens through the flying lids, fins full width; the shrimps shove the huge jar back
tears the tiny jar off a crate and sweeps it the full frame width past the huge one
both shrimps pitch three roe beads across the frame and he takes all three into that tiny jar in one sweep
a shrimp slaps the price card flat on the tiny jar as he slams its lid shut with his tail in the turn
drives the tiny tagged jar at the lens, the card flat to the glass, three beads plain inside
swings the huge empty jar out of frame and brings the tiny one back at the glass, crates rushing past
drives the tiny jar into the lens, three beads inside, the card flat to the glass; the shrimps whip past the glass

must_appear: the huge jar packed with roe fills the frame in the first beat; at 6.40 three roe beads go into the tiny jar; at 7.10 the card marked 1499 is slapped flat on it; at 7.80 and 9.25 he drives that jar at the lens, three beads inside, the card flat to the glass
negative_prompt: printed sentences, cyrillic words, spoken digits, a decimal point on the card, superscript digits, subtitles, watermark, speech bubble, brand logos, duplicate props, a second tiny jar, floating objects, black bars, a horizontal 16:9 frame, night, murky water, studio lighting, a prop worked in place, hero riding a belt or cart, a hero held in one pose, parked camera, push in, motionless or empty background, an island seen whole, open sea and sky, wide shot, the hero's back to the camera, a motionless first or last second, speech after 5.75, offscreen narration, English speech, a second herring
